407	    def create_group(self, payload: object) -> Dict[str, Any]:
408	        """Validate a group-creation payload and atomically create the group.
409	
410	        ``group_id`` and ``creator_device_id`` must be non-empty strings and
411	        ``member_device_ids`` a non-empty array of non-empty strings. The
412	        creator must be an active device; it always becomes the first member.
413	        A repeated ``group_id`` is a 409 naming ``group_id``.
414	        """
415	        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
416	            raise ServiceError("request body must be a JSON object",
417	                               "request_body")
418	        for name in ("group_id", "creator_device_id"):
419	            if name not in payload:
420	                raise ServiceError(f"missing required field: {name}", name)
421	            if not is_nonempty_string(payload[name]):
422	                raise ServiceError(
423	                    f"field must be a non-empty string: {name}", name)
424	
425	        if "member_device_ids" not in payload:
426	            raise ServiceError("missing required field: member_device_ids",
427	                               "member_device_ids")
428	        raw_members = payload["member_device_ids"]
429	        if not isinstance(raw_members, list) or not raw_members:
430	            raise ServiceError(
431	                "field must be a non-empty array: member_device_ids",
432	                "member_device_ids")
433	        for index, element in enumerate(raw_members):
434	            if not is_nonempty_string(element):
435	                raise ServiceError(
436	                    "every member must be a non-empty string: "
437	                    f"member_device_ids[{index}]",
438	                    "member_device_ids")
439	
440	        try:
441	            group = self.store.create_group(
442	                payload["group_id"], payload["creator_device_id"],
443	                list(raw_members))
444	        except GroupError as error:
445	            if error.reason == GROUP_DUPLICATE_ID:
446	                raise ServiceError(
447	                    f"group_id already exists: {payload['group_id']}",
448	                    "group_id", status_code=409)
449	            if error.reason == GROUP_CREATOR_UNKNOWN:
450	                raise ServiceError(
451	                    f"device not found: {payload['creator_device_id']}",
452	                    "creator_device_id", status_code=404)
453	            raise ServiceError("creator_device_id is revoked",
454	                               "creator_device_id", status_code=409)
455	        return self.store.group_view(group)

457	    def get_group(self, group_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
458	        """Return the group's public snapshot; 404/field=group_id if unknown."""
459	        group = self.store.get_group(group_id)
460	        if group is None:
461	            raise ServiceError(f"group not found: {group_id}",
462	                               "group_id", status_code=404)

465	    def _validate_member_change(self, payload: object
466	                                ) -> Tuple[str, str]:
467	        """Validate the shared body of add/remove-member requests."""
468	        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
469	            raise ServiceError("request body must be a JSON object",
470	                               "request_body")
471	        for name in ("actor_device_id", "device_id"):
472	            if name not in payload:
473	                raise ServiceError(f"missing required field: {name}", name)
474	            if not is_nonempty_string(payload[name]):
475	                raise ServiceError(
476	                    f"field must be a non-empty string: {name}", name)
477	        return payload["actor_device_id"], payload["device_id"]
478	
479	    def _group_member_error(self, error: GroupError,
480	                            group_id: str) -> ServiceError:
481	        """Translate a storage membership failure into a ServiceError."""
482	        status_code, field = self._GROUP_MEMBER_ERROR_MAP[error.reason]
483	        if error.reason == GROUP_UNKNOWN:
484	            text = f"group not found: {group_id}"
485	        elif error.reason == GROUP_ACTOR_UNKNOWN:
486	            text = "actor_device_id is not a registered device"
487	        elif error.reason == GROUP_DEVICE_UNKNOWN:
488	            text = "device_id is not a registered device"
489	        elif field == "actor_device_id":
490	            text = "actor_device_id is revoked or is not the group creator"
491	        else:
492	            text = "device_id is revoked and cannot be added to the group"
493	        return ServiceError(text, field, status_code=status_code)

495	    def add_group_member(self, group_id: str,
496	                         payload: object) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], int]:
497	        """Validate and add one member; 201 created, 200 when already a member.
498	
499	        Only the creator may change membership. Unknown group/actor/target
500	        device are 404 with the corresponding field; a revoked or
501	        non-creator actor and a revoked target are 409.
502	        """
503	        actor_device_id, device_id = self._validate_member_change(payload)
504	        try:
505	            group, created = self.store.add_group_member(
506	                group_id, actor_device_id, device_id)
507	        except GroupError as error:
508	            raise self._group_member_error(error, group_id)
509	        return self.store.group_view(group), 201 if created else 200

517	        404/field=device_id.

572	    # -- group-session sync ------------------------------------------------
573	
574	    #: Maps a group-session sync failure reason to (HTTP status, field name).
575	    #: Only an unknown session is a 404; every device-side problem (unknown,
576	    #: revoked, or outside the frozen member set) is a 409 naming device_id,
577	    #: mirroring the group-session message read contract.
578	    _SYNC_ERROR_MAP = {
579	        SYNC_SESSION_UNKNOWN: (404, "session_id"),
580	        SYNC_DEVICE_UNKNOWN: (409, "device_id"),
581	        SYNC_DEVICE_INACTIVE: (409, "device_id"),
582	        SYNC_DEVICE_NOT_MEMBER: (409, "device_id"),
583	        SYNC_CURSOR_CONFLICT: (409, "cursor"),
584	    }
585	
586	    def _sync_error(self, error: GroupSyncError,
587	                    session_id: str) -> ServiceError:
588	        """Translate a storage :class:`GroupSyncError` into a ServiceError."""
589	        status_code, field = self._SYNC_ERROR_MAP[error.reason]
590	        if error.reason == SYNC_SESSION_UNKNOWN:
591	            text = f"session not found: {session_id}"
592	        elif error.reason == SYNC_CURSOR_CONFLICT:
593	            text = "cursor is out of range or moved backwards"
594	        elif error.reason == SYNC_DEVICE_UNKNOWN:
595	            text = "device_id is not a registered device"
596	        elif error.reason == SYNC_DEVICE_INACTIVE:
597	            text = "device_id is revoked"
598	        else:
599	            text = "device_id is not a frozen member of this group session"
600	        return ServiceError(text, field, status_code=status_code)
601	
602	    def sync_group_messages(self, session_id: str, device_id: str,
603	                            after: Optional[int], limit: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
604	        """Return one ascending sync page of a group session's messages.
605	
606	        With *after* ``None`` the device's stored cursor is the start and is
607	        advanced under the store lock (an empty page leaves it unchanged); an
608	        explicit non-negative *after* queries from there without touching the
609	        stored cursor. Authorization follows the frozen member set.
610	        """
611	        try:
612	            return self.store.group_sync_page(
613	                session_id, device_id, after, limit)
614	        except GroupSyncError as error:
615	            raise self._sync_error(error, session_id)
616	
617	    def sync_group_checkpoint(self, session_id: str,
618	                              payload: object) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], int]:
619	        """Validate and move a device's group-session sync cursor.
620	
621	        ``device_id`` must be a non-empty string and ``cursor`` an integer in
622	        ``0..max_sequence``. A forward move returns 201 with a refreshed
623	        ``updated_at``; an equal cursor returns 200 unchanged; a backward or
624	        out-of-range cursor returns 409/field=cursor. Unknown session is
625	        404/session_id; an unknown, revoked or non-frozen-member device is
626	        409/device_id.
627	        """
628	        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
629	            raise ServiceError("request body must be a JSON object",
630	                               "request_body")
631	        if "device_id" not in payload:
632	            raise ServiceError("missing required field: device_id", "device_id")
633	        if not is_nonempty_string(payload["device_id"]):
634	            raise ServiceError(
635	                "field must be a non-empty string: device_id", "device_id")
636	        if "cursor" not in payload:
637	            raise ServiceError("missing required field: cursor", "cursor")
638	        cursor = payload["cursor"]
639	        # bool is a subclass of int; reject it explicitly.
640	        if not isinstance(cursor, int) or isinstance(cursor, bool):
641	            raise ServiceError("field must be an integer: cursor", "cursor")
642	        if cursor < 0:
643	            raise ServiceError("field must be a non-negative integer: cursor",
644	                               "cursor")
645	
646	        try:
647	            view, advanced = self.store.group_sync_checkpoint(
648	                session_id, payload["device_id"], cursor)
649	        except GroupSyncError as error:
650	            raise self._sync_error(error, session_id)
651	        return view, 201 if advanced else 200

655	    def post_message(self, payload: object) -> Dict[str, Any]:
656	        """Validate a message-send payload and atomically append the message.
657

"""Business logic and request validation for device registration/queries.

The service never sees plaintext messages or private keys: it validates and
stores identifiers and public-key material only.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple

from .crypto import is_nonempty_string, load_public_key
from .models import Device, SignedPreKey
from .storage import (
    CLAIM_NO_PREKEY,
    CLAIM_RECIPIENT_REVOKED,
    CLAIM_RECIPIENT_UNKNOWN,
    DELIVERY_BAD_SEQUENCE,
    DELIVERY_DEVICE_INACTIVE,
    DELIVERY_DEVICE_MISMATCH,
    DELIVERY_MESSAGE_UNKNOWN,
    DELIVERY_SESSION_UNKNOWN,
    DEVICE_REVOKED,
    DEVICE_UNKNOWN,
    GROUP_ACTOR_NOT_CREATOR,
    GROUP_ACTOR_REVOKED,
    GROUP_ACTOR_UNKNOWN,
    GROUP_CREATOR_REVOKED,
    GROUP_CREATOR_UNKNOWN,
    GROUP_DEVICE_REVOKED,
    GROUP_DEVICE_UNKNOWN,
    GROUP_DUPLICATE_ID,
    GROUP_SESSION_GROUP_UNKNOWN,
    GROUP_SESSION_INITIATOR_INACTIVE,
    GROUP_SESSION_INITIATOR_NOT_MEMBER,
    GROUP_SESSION_INITIATOR_UNKNOWN,
    GROUP_UNKNOWN,
    MESSAGE_BAD_SEQUENCE,
    MESSAGE_DEVICE_INACTIVE,
    MESSAGE_DUPLICATE_ID,
    MESSAGE_DUPLICATE_NONCE,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_INACTIVE,
    MESSAGE_SESSION_UNKNOWN,
    PREKEY_CONFLICT,
    SESSION_INITIATOR_REVOKED,
    SESSION_INITIATOR_UNKNOWN,
    SESSION_PREKEY_CONSUMED,
    SESSION_PREKEY_REVOKED,
    SESSION_PREKEY_UNKNOWN,
    SESSION_RECIPIENT_REVOKED,
    SESSION_RECIPIENT_UNKNOWN,
    SYNC_CURSOR_CONFLICT,
    SYNC_DEVICE_INACTIVE,
    SYNC_DEVICE_NOT_MEMBER,
    SYNC_DEVICE_UNKNOWN,
    SYNC_SESSION_UNKNOWN,
    DeviceStore,
    DeviceUpdateError,
    DeliveryError,
    GroupError,
    GroupSyncError,
    MessageCreateError,
    MessageListError,
    PreKeyClaimError,
    SessionCreateError,
)

_REQUIRED_SCALAR_FIELDS = ("user_id", "device_id", "identity_key")
_SESSION_SCALAR_FIELDS = (
    "initiator_device_id", "recipient_device_id", "prekey_id", "ephemeral_key")
_MESSAGE_STRING_FIELDS = (
    "session_id", "sender_device_id", "message_id", "nonce", "ciphertext")

#: Maps a storage-level message-append failure reason to (HTTP status, field).
_MESSAGE_CREATE_ERROR_MAP = {
    MESSAGE_SESSION_UNKNOWN: (404, "session_id"),
    MESSAGE_SENDER_INACTIVE: (409, "sender_device_id"),
    MESSAGE_DUPLICATE_ID: (409, "message_id"),
    MESSAGE_BAD_SEQUENCE: (409, "sequence"),
    MESSAGE_DUPLICATE_NONCE: (409, "nonce"),
}

#: Maps a storage-level session failure reason to (HTTP status, field name).
_SESSION_ERROR_MAP = {
    SESSION_INITIATOR_UNKNOWN: (404, "initiator_device_id"),
    SESSION_RECIPIENT_UNKNOWN: (404, "recipient_device_id"),
    SESSION_PREKEY_UNKNOWN: (404, "prekey_id"),
    SESSION_INITIATOR_REVOKED: (409, "initiator_device_id"),
    SESSION_RECIPIENT_REVOKED: (409, "recipient_device_id"),
    SESSION_PREKEY_REVOKED: (409, "prekey_id"),
    SESSION_PREKEY_CONSUMED: (409, "prekey_id"),
}


class ServiceError(Exception):
    """A validation/lookup failure carrying an HTTP status and a field name."""

    def __init__(self, message: str, field: str = "", status_code: int = 400) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.message = message
        self.field = field
        self.status_code = status_code

    def to_body(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """JSON-serializable error body naming the offending field."""
        body: Dict[str, Any] = {"message": self.message}
        if self.field:
            body["field"] = self.field
        return body


class DeviceService:
    """Validates payloads and coordinates the :class:`DeviceStore`."""

    def __init__(self, store: Optional[DeviceStore] = None) -> None:
        self.store = store if store is not None else DeviceStore()

    # -- registration ------------------------------------------------------

    def register(self, payload: object) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Validate and persist a registration payload; return the 201 body."""
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            raise ServiceError("request body must be a JSON object", "request_body")

        for name in _REQUIRED_SCALAR_FIELDS:
            if name not in payload:
                raise ServiceError(f"missing required field: {name}", name)
            if not is_nonempty_string(payload[name]):
                raise ServiceError(f"field must be a non-empty string: {name}", name)

        if "signed_prekeys" not in payload:
            raise ServiceError("missing required field: signed_prekeys",
                               "signed_prekeys")
        raw_prekeys = payload["signed_prekeys"]
        if not isinstance(raw_prekeys, list):
            raise ServiceError("field must be an array: signed_prekeys",
                               "signed_prekeys")

        prekeys: List[SignedPreKey] = []
        seen_key_ids: set = set()
        for index, element in enumerate(raw_prekeys):
            prefix = f"signed_prekeys[{index}]"
            if not isinstance(element, dict):
                raise ServiceError(f"array element must be an object: {prefix}", prefix)
            for subfield in ("key_id", "public_key"):
                path = f"{prefix}.{subfield}"
                if subfield not in element:
                    raise ServiceError(f"missing required field: {path}", path)
                if not is_nonempty_string(element[subfield]):
                    raise ServiceError(
                        f"field must be a non-empty string: {path}", path)
            if element["key_id"] in seen_key_ids:
                raise ServiceError(
                    f"duplicate key_id in signed_prekeys: {element['key_id']}",
                    f"{prefix}.key_id")
            if load_public_key(element["public_key"]) is None:
                raise ServiceError(
                    f"field is not a valid public key: {prefix}.public_key",
                    f"{prefix}.public_key")
            seen_key_ids.add(element["key_id"])
            prekeys.append(SignedPreKey(element["key_id"], element["public_key"]))

        if load_public_key(payload["identity_key"]) is None:
            raise ServiceError("field is not a valid public key: identity_key",
                               "identity_key")

        device = Device(
            user_id=payload["user_id"],
            device_id=payload["device_id"],
            identity_key=payload["identity_key"],
            prekeys=prekeys,
        )
        if not self.store.add_device(device):
            raise ServiceError(
                f"device_id already registered: {device.device_id}",
                "device_id", status_code=409)

        return {"device_id": device.device_id,
                "registered_at": device.registered_at}

    # -- lookup ------------------------------------------------------------

    def get_device(self, device_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Return the public device record; raise :class:`ServiceError` if absent."""
        view = self.store.public_view(device_id)
        if view is None:
            raise ServiceError(f"device not found: {device_id}",
                               "device_id", status_code=404)
        return view

    # -- revocation --------------------------------------------------------

    def revoke_device(self, device_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Revoke a device (and its pre-keys); idempotent, 404 when unknown."""
        device = self.store.revoke_device(device_id)
        if device is None:
            raise ServiceError(f"device not found: {device_id}",
                               "device_id", status_code=404)
        return {"device_id": device.device_id, "revoked": True}

    def revoke_prekey(self, device_id: str, key_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Revoke one pre-key; idempotent, 404 on unknown device/key."""
        device, key_found = self.store.revoke_prekey_by_id(device_id, key_id)
        if device is None:
            raise ServiceError(f"device not found: {device_id}",
                               "device_id", status_code=404)
        if not key_found:
            raise ServiceError(f"pre-key not found: {key_id}",
                               "key_id", status_code=404)
        return {"device_id": device.device_id, "key_id": key_id, "revoked": True}

    # -- identity rotation & pre-key replenishment -------------------------

    def rotate_identity_key(self, device_id: str,
                            payload: object) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Validate and apply an identity-key rotation.

        The new ``identity_key`` must be a non-empty, valid public key. The
        same value as the current key is a no-op that leaves ``rotated_at``
        unchanged; a changed value stamps a fresh UTC ISO-8601 ``rotated_at``.
        Unknown device is 404, revoked device is 409 (both field
        ``device_id``); nothing is written on failure.
        """
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            raise ServiceError("request body must be a JSON object",
                               "request_body")
        if "identity_key" not in payload:
            raise ServiceError("missing required field: identity_key",
                               "identity_key")
        if not is_nonempty_string(payload["identity_key"]):
            raise ServiceError(
                "field must be a non-empty string: identity_key",
                "identity_key")
        if load_public_key(payload["identity_key"]) is None:
            raise ServiceError(
                "field is not a valid public key: identity_key",
                "identity_key")

        try:
            view, _changed = self.store.rotate_identity_key(
                device_id, payload["identity_key"])
        except DeviceUpdateError as error:
            raise self._device_update_error(error, device_id)
        return view

    def add_prekey(self, device_id: str,
                   payload: object) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], int]:
        """Validate and append a pre-key, or confirm an identical existing one.

        ``key_id`` and ``public_key`` must be non-empty strings and the key
        must parse as a public key. A new id appends in order (201); an
        existing id with the same, non-revoked key is idempotent (200); a
        changed key or a revoked id conflicts (409/key_id). Unknown device is
        404, revoked device 409 (field ``device_id``). Returns
        ``(body, status_code)``.
        """
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            raise ServiceError("request body must be a JSON object",
                               "request_body")
        for name in ("key_id", "public_key"):
            if name not in payload:
                raise ServiceError(f"missing required field: {name}", name)
            if not is_nonempty_string(payload[name]):
                raise ServiceError(
                    f"field must be a non-empty string: {name}", name)
        if load_public_key(payload["public_key"]) is None:
            raise ServiceError(
                "field is not a valid public key: public_key", "public_key")

        try:
            view, created = self.store.add_prekey(
                device_id, payload["key_id"], payload["public_key"])
        except DeviceUpdateError as error:
            raise self._device_update_error(error, device_id)
        return view, 201 if created else 200

    @staticmethod
    def _device_update_error(error: DeviceUpdateError,
                             device_id: str) -> ServiceError:
        """Translate a rotation/add-pre-key storage failure to a ServiceError."""
        if error.reason == DEVICE_UNKNOWN:
            return ServiceError(f"device not found: {device_id}",
                                "device_id", status_code=404)
        if error.reason == DEVICE_REVOKED:
            return ServiceError("device_id is revoked",
                                "device_id", status_code=409)
        if error.reason == PREKEY_CONFLICT:
            return ServiceError(
                "key_id already exists with a different key or is revoked",
                "key_id", status_code=409)
        raise  # pragma: no cover - defensive

    # -- one-time pre-key claims ------------------------------------------

    def claim_prekey(self, payload: object) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], int]:
        """Validate a claim payload and atomically claim one pre-key.

        ``recipient_device_id`` and ``claim_id`` must be non-empty strings.
        The first available (registered-order, un-revoked, un-consumed)
        pre-key is marked consumed and returned with 201. A repeated
        ``claim_id`` returns the original response with 200 and consumes no
        further key; a different ``claim_id`` claims the next available key.
        Unknown recipient is 404, revoked recipient 409 (field
        ``recipient_device_id``), and no available key is 409/field
        ``prekey_id``. Returns ``(body, status_code)``.
        """
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            raise ServiceError("request body must be a JSON object",
                               "request_body")
        for name in ("recipient_device_id", "claim_id"):
            if name not in payload:
                raise ServiceError(f"missing required field: {name}", name)
            if not is_nonempty_string(payload[name]):
                raise ServiceError(
                    f"field must be a non-empty string: {name}", name)

        try:
            view, created = self.store.claim_prekey(
                payload["recipient_device_id"], payload["claim_id"])
        except PreKeyClaimError as error:
            raise self._claim_error(error, payload["recipient_device_id"])
        return view, 201 if created else 200

    @staticmethod
    def _claim_error(error: PreKeyClaimError,
                     recipient_device_id: str) -> ServiceError:
        """Translate a claim storage failure into a ServiceError."""
        if error.reason == CLAIM_RECIPIENT_UNKNOWN:
            return ServiceError(f"device not found: {recipient_device_id}",
                                "recipient_device_id", status_code=404)
        if error.reason == CLAIM_RECIPIENT_REVOKED:
            return ServiceError("recipient_device_id is revoked",
                                "recipient_device_id", status_code=409)
        return ServiceError("no pre-key available for this device",
                            "prekey_id", status_code=409)

    # -- sessions ----------------------------------------------------------

    def create_session(self, payload: object) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Validate a session-negotiation payload and atomically create it.

        Every request creates a fresh session (a new ``session_id``); repeated
        POSTs are never deduplicated.
        """
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            raise ServiceError("request body must be a JSON object",
                               "request_body")

        for name in _SESSION_SCALAR_FIELDS:
            if name not in payload:
                raise ServiceError(f"missing required field: {name}", name)
            if not is_nonempty_string(payload[name]):
                raise ServiceError(
                    f"field must be a non-empty string: {name}", name)

        if load_public_key(payload["ephemeral_key"]) is None:
            raise ServiceError(
                "field is not a valid public key: ephemeral_key",
                "ephemeral_key")

        if payload["initiator_device_id"] == payload["recipient_device_id"]:
            raise ServiceError(
                "recipient_device_id must differ from initiator_device_id",
                "recipient_device_id")

        try:
            session = self.store.create_session(
                payload["initiator_device_id"],
                payload["recipient_device_id"],
                payload["prekey_id"],
                payload["ephemeral_key"])
        except SessionCreateError as error:
            status_code, field = _SESSION_ERROR_MAP[error.reason]
            if status_code == 404:
                if field == "prekey_id":
                    message = f"pre-key not found: {payload['prekey_id']}"
                else:
                    device_id = payload[field]
                    message = f"device not found: {device_id}"
            elif error.reason == SESSION_PREKEY_CONSUMED:
                message = (f"prekey_id has already been claimed: "
                           f"{payload['prekey_id']}")
            else:
                message = f"{field} is revoked"
            raise ServiceError(message, field, status_code=status_code)

        return self.store.session_view(session.session_id)  # type: ignore[return-value]

    def get_session(self, session_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Return the immutable eight-field session snapshot; 404 if unknown."""
        view = self.store.session_view(session_id)
        if view is None:
            raise ServiceError(f"session not found: {session_id}",
                               "session_id", status_code=404)
        return view

    # -- groups ------------------------------------------------------------

    #: Maps a storage-level group-membership failure to (HTTP status, field).
    _GROUP_MEMBER_ERROR_MAP = {
        GROUP_UNKNOWN: (404, "group_id"),
        GROUP_ACTOR_UNKNOWN: (404, "actor_device_id"),
        GROUP_ACTOR_REVOKED: (409, "actor_device_id"),
        GROUP_ACTOR_NOT_CREATOR: (409, "actor_device_id"),
        GROUP_DEVICE_UNKNOWN: (404, "device_id"),
        GROUP_DEVICE_REVOKED: (409, "device_id"),
    }

    def create_group(self, payload: object) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Validate a group-creation payload and atomically create the group.

        ``group_id`` and ``creator_device_id`` must be non-empty strings and
        ``member_device_ids`` a non-empty array of non-empty strings. The
        creator must be an active device; it always becomes the first member.
        A repeated ``group_id`` is a 409 naming ``group_id``.
        """
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            raise ServiceError("request body must be a JSON object",
                               "request_body")
        for name in ("group_id", "creator_device_id"):
            if name not in payload:
                raise ServiceError(f"missing required field: {name}", name)
            if not is_nonempty_string(payload[name]):
                raise ServiceError(
                    f"field must be a non-empty string: {name}", name)

        if "member_device_ids" not in payload:
            raise ServiceError("missing required field: member_device_ids",
                               "member_device_ids")
        raw_members = payload["member_device_ids"]
        if not isinstance(raw_members, list) or not raw_members:
            raise ServiceError(
                "field must be a non-empty array: member_device_ids",
                "member_device_ids")
        for index, element in enumerate(raw_members):
            if not is_nonempty_string(element):
                raise ServiceError(
                    "every member must be a non-empty string: "
                    f"member_device_ids[{index}]",
                    "member_device_ids")

        try:
            group = self.store.create_group(
                payload["group_id"], payload["creator_device_id"],
                list(raw_members))
        except GroupError as error:
            if error.reason == GROUP_DUPLICATE_ID:
                raise ServiceError(
                    f"group_id already exists: {payload['group_id']}",
                    "group_id", status_code=409)
            if error.reason == GROUP_CREATOR_UNKNOWN:
                raise ServiceError(
                    f"device not found: {payload['creator_device_id']}",
                    "creator_device_id", status_code=404)
            raise ServiceError("creator_device_id is revoked",
                               "creator_device_id", status_code=409)
        return self.store.group_view(group)

    def get_group(self, group_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Return the group's public snapshot; 404/field=group_id if unknown."""
        group = self.store.get_group(group_id)
        if group is None:
            raise ServiceError(f"group not found: {group_id}",
                               "group_id", status_code=404)
        return self.store.group_view(group)

    def _validate_member_change(self, payload: object
                                ) -> Tuple[str, str]:
        """Validate the shared body of add/remove-member requests."""
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            raise ServiceError("request body must be a JSON object",
                               "request_body")
        for name in ("actor_device_id", "device_id"):
            if name not in payload:
                raise ServiceError(f"missing required field: {name}", name)
            if not is_nonempty_string(payload[name]):
                raise ServiceError(
                    f"field must be a non-empty string: {name}", name)
        return payload["actor_device_id"], payload["device_id"]

    def _group_member_error(self, error: GroupError,
                            group_id: str) -> ServiceError:
        """Translate a storage membership failure into a ServiceError."""
        status_code, field = self._GROUP_MEMBER_ERROR_MAP[error.reason]
        if error.reason == GROUP_UNKNOWN:
            text = f"group not found: {group_id}"
        elif error.reason == GROUP_ACTOR_UNKNOWN:
            text = "actor_device_id is not a registered device"
        elif error.reason == GROUP_DEVICE_UNKNOWN:
            text = "device_id is not a registered device"
        elif field == "actor_device_id":
            text = "actor_device_id is revoked or is not the group creator"
        else:
            text = "device_id is revoked and cannot be added to the group"
        return ServiceError(text, field, status_code=status_code)

    def add_group_member(self, group_id: str,
                         payload: object) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], int]:
        """Validate and add one member; 201 created, 200 when already a member.

        Only the creator may change membership. Unknown group/actor/target
        device are 404 with the corresponding field; a revoked or
        non-creator actor and a revoked target are 409.
        """
        actor_device_id, device_id = self._validate_member_change(payload)
        try:
            group, created = self.store.add_group_member(
                group_id, actor_device_id, device_id)
        except GroupError as error:
            raise self._group_member_error(error, group_id)
        return self.store.group_view(group), 201 if created else 200

    def remove_group_member(self, group_id: str, payload: object
                            ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Validate and remove one member; always 200 (idempotent).

        Only the creator may remove members. Removing a device that is not
        on the roster is a no-op; an id that has never been registered is
        404/field=device_id.
        """
        actor_device_id, device_id = self._validate_member_change(payload)
        try:
            group = self.store.remove_group_member(
                group_id, actor_device_id, device_id)
        except GroupError as error:
            raise self._group_member_error(error, group_id)
        return self.store.group_view(group)

    # -- group sessions ----------------------------------------------------

    def create_group_session(self, payload: object) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Validate a group-session payload and atomically create one.

        Every request creates a fresh session (a new ``session_id``);
        repeated POSTs are never deduplicated. The member list is frozen at
        creation. The initiator must be an active current member.
        """
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            raise ServiceError("request body must be a JSON object",
                               "request_body")
        for name in ("group_id", "initiator_device_id", "ephemeral_key"):
            if name not in payload:
                raise ServiceError(f"missing required field: {name}", name)
            if not is_nonempty_string(payload[name]):
                raise ServiceError(
                    f"field must be a non-empty string: {name}", name)

        try:
            session = self.store.create_group_session(
                payload["group_id"], payload["initiator_device_id"],
                payload["ephemeral_key"])
        except GroupError as error:
            if error.reason == GROUP_SESSION_GROUP_UNKNOWN:
                raise ServiceError(
                    f"group not found: {payload['group_id']}",
                    "group_id", status_code=404)
            if error.reason == GROUP_SESSION_INITIATOR_UNKNOWN:
                raise ServiceError(
                    f"device not found: {payload['initiator_device_id']}",
                    "initiator_device_id", status_code=404)
            raise ServiceError(
                "initiator_device_id is revoked or is not a group member",
                "initiator_device_id", status_code=409)
        return self.store.group_session_view(session)

    def get_group_session(self, session_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Return the frozen group-session snapshot; 404/field=session_id."""
        session = self.store.get_group_session(session_id)
        if session is None:
            raise ServiceError(f"session not found: {session_id}",
                               "session_id", status_code=404)
        return self.store.group_session_view(session)

    # -- group-session sync ------------------------------------------------

    #: Maps a group-session sync failure reason to (HTTP status, field name).
    #: Only an unknown session is a 404; every device-side problem (unknown,
    #: revoked, or outside the frozen member set) is a 409 naming device_id,
    #: mirroring the group-session message read contract.
    _SYNC_ERROR_MAP = {
        SYNC_SESSION_UNKNOWN: (404, "session_id"),
        SYNC_DEVICE_UNKNOWN: (409, "device_id"),
        SYNC_DEVICE_INACTIVE: (409, "device_id"),
        SYNC_DEVICE_NOT_MEMBER: (409, "device_id"),
        SYNC_CURSOR_CONFLICT: (409, "cursor"),
    }

    def _sync_error(self, error: GroupSyncError,
                    session_id: str) -> ServiceError:
        """Translate a storage :class:`GroupSyncError` into a ServiceError."""
        status_code, field = self._SYNC_ERROR_MAP[error.reason]
        if error.reason == SYNC_SESSION_UNKNOWN:
            text = f"session not found: {session_id}"
        elif error.reason == SYNC_CURSOR_CONFLICT:
            text = "cursor is out of range or moved backwards"
        elif error.reason == SYNC_DEVICE_UNKNOWN:
            text = "device_id is not a registered device"
        elif error.reason == SYNC_DEVICE_INACTIVE:
            text = "device_id is revoked"
        else:
            text = "device_id is not a frozen member of this group session"
        return ServiceError(text, field, status_code=status_code)

    def sync_group_messages(self, session_id: str, device_id: str,
                            after: Optional[int], limit: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Return one ascending sync page of a group session's messages.

        With *after* ``None`` the device's stored cursor is the start and is
        advanced under the store lock (an empty page leaves it unchanged); an
        explicit non-negative *after* queries from there without touching the
        stored cursor. Authorization follows the frozen member set.
        """
        try:
            return self.store.group_sync_page(
                session_id, device_id, after, limit)
        except GroupSyncError as error:
            raise self._sync_error(error, session_id)

    def sync_group_checkpoint(self, session_id: str,
                              payload: object) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], int]:
        """Validate and move a device's group-session sync cursor.

        ``device_id`` must be a non-empty string and ``cursor`` an integer in
        ``0..max_sequence``. A forward move returns 201 with a refreshed
        ``updated_at``; an equal cursor returns 200 unchanged; a backward or
        out-of-range cursor returns 409/field=cursor. Unknown session is
        404/session_id; an unknown, revoked or non-frozen-member device is
        409/device_id.
        """
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            raise ServiceError("request body must be a JSON object",
                               "request_body")
        if "device_id" not in payload:
            raise ServiceError("missing required field: device_id", "device_id")
        if not is_nonempty_string(payload["device_id"]):
            raise ServiceError(
                "field must be a non-empty string: device_id", "device_id")
        if "cursor" not in payload:
            raise ServiceError("missing required field: cursor", "cursor")
        cursor = payload["cursor"]
        # bool is a subclass of int; reject it explicitly.
        if not isinstance(cursor, int) or isinstance(cursor, bool):
            raise ServiceError("field must be an integer: cursor", "cursor")
        if cursor < 0:
            raise ServiceError("field must be a non-negative integer: cursor",
                               "cursor")

        try:
            view, advanced = self.store.group_sync_checkpoint(
                session_id, payload["device_id"], cursor)
        except GroupSyncError as error:
            raise self._sync_error(error, session_id)
        return view, 201 if advanced else 200

    # -- messages ----------------------------------------------------------

    def post_message(self, payload: object) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Validate a message-send payload and atomically append the message.

        ``sequence`` must continue the session's stream (starting at 1, no
        gaps or duplicates), ``message_id`` must be unique within the session,
        and ``nonce`` must not have been accepted before in the same session;
        each violation is a 409 naming the offending field, as is a
        revoked/unknown sender device. The identical nonce in a different
        session is allowed.
        """
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            raise ServiceError("request body must be a JSON object",
                               "request_body")

        for name in _MESSAGE_STRING_FIELDS:
            if name not in payload:
                raise ServiceError(f"missing required field: {name}", name)
            if not is_nonempty_string(payload[name]):
                raise ServiceError(
                    f"field must be a non-empty string: {name}", name)

        if "sequence" not in payload:
            raise ServiceError("missing required field: sequence", "sequence")
        sequence = payload["sequence"]
        # bool is a subclass of int; reject it explicitly.
        if not isinstance(sequence, int) or isinstance(sequence, bool):
            raise ServiceError("field must be an integer: sequence", "sequence")

        try:
            message = self.store.append_message(
                payload["session_id"],
                payload["sender_device_id"],
                payload["message_id"],
                sequence,
                payload["nonce"],
                payload["ciphertext"])
        except MessageCreateError as error:
            status_code, field = _MESSAGE_CREATE_ERROR_MAP[error.reason]
            if error.reason == MESSAGE_SESSION_UNKNOWN:
                message_text = f"session not found: {payload['session_id']}"
            elif error.reason == MESSAGE_SENDER_INACTIVE:
                message_text = "sender_device_id is not an active device"
            elif error.reason == MESSAGE_DUPLICATE_ID:
                message_text = (f"message_id already exists in session: "
                                f"{payload['message_id']}")
            elif error.reason == MESSAGE_BAD_SEQUENCE:
                message_text = (f"sequence must continue the session stream "
                                f"(got {sequence})")
            else:
                message_text = (f"nonce already used in this session: "
                                f"{payload['nonce']}")
            raise ServiceError(message_text, field, status_code=status_code)

        return self.store.message_view(message)

    def list_messages(self, session_id: str, device_id: str, after: int,
                      limit: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Return one page of a session's messages plus the resume cursor."""
        try:
            messages, next_after = self.store.message_page(
                session_id, device_id, after, limit)
        except MessageListError as error:
            if error.reason == MESSAGE_SESSION_UNKNOWN:
                raise ServiceError(f"session not found: {session_id}",
                                   "session_id", status_code=404)
            if error.reason == MESSAGE_DEVICE_INACTIVE:
                raise ServiceError("device_id is not an active device",
                                   "device_id", status_code=409)
            raise  # pragma: no cover - defensive
        return {"messages": messages, "next_after": next_after}

    # -- reliable delivery -------------------------------------------------

    #: Maps a delivery failure reason to (HTTP status, field name).
    _DELIVERY_ERROR_MAP = {
        DELIVERY_SESSION_UNKNOWN: (404, "session_id"),
        DELIVERY_MESSAGE_UNKNOWN: (404, "message_id"),
        DELIVERY_DEVICE_INACTIVE: (409, "device_id"),
        DELIVERY_DEVICE_MISMATCH: (409, "device_id"),
        DELIVERY_BAD_SEQUENCE: (409, "sequence"),
    }

    def _delivery_error(self, error: DeliveryError,
                        session_id: str, message_id: str,
                        sequence: Optional[int] = None) -> ServiceError:
        """Translate a storage :class:`DeliveryError` into a ServiceError."""
        status_code, field = self._DELIVERY_ERROR_MAP[error.reason]
        if error.reason == DELIVERY_SESSION_UNKNOWN:
            text = f"session not found: {session_id}"
        elif error.reason == DELIVERY_MESSAGE_UNKNOWN:
            text = f"message not found: {message_id}"
        elif error.reason == DELIVERY_BAD_SEQUENCE:
            text = f"sequence does not match the message (got {sequence})"
        else:
            text = "device_id is not the active recipient of this session"
        return ServiceError(text, field, status_code=status_code)

    def retry_message(self, session_id: str, message_id: str,
                      payload: object) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], int]:
        """Validate and record one delivery attempt for a message.

        Returns ``(body, 201)`` for the first attempt and ``(body, 200)`` for
        a repeated attempt. A repeated ``attempt_id`` is not counted again;
        retries after an ack still succeed with status ``acked``.
        """
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            raise ServiceError("request body must be a JSON object",
                               "request_body")
        for name in ("device_id", "attempt_id"):
            if name not in payload:
                raise ServiceError(f"missing required field: {name}", name)
            if not is_nonempty_string(payload[name]):
                raise ServiceError(
                    f"field must be a non-empty string: {name}", name)

        try:
            view, created = self.store.retry_message(
                session_id, message_id,
                payload["device_id"], payload["attempt_id"])
        except DeliveryError as error:
            raise self._delivery_error(error, session_id, message_id)
        return view, 201 if created else 200

    def ack_message(self, session_id: str, payload: object
                    ) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], int]:
        """Validate and record an acknowledgement.

        The session is taken from the URL; the body carries ``device_id``,
        ``message_id`` and the integer ``sequence``. The first ack returns 201
        and marks the message acked; repeated acks return 200 and leave the
        acked state in place.
        """
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            raise ServiceError("request body must be a JSON object",
                               "request_body")
        for name in ("device_id", "message_id"):
            if name not in payload:
                raise ServiceError(f"missing required field: {name}", name)
            if not is_nonempty_string(payload[name]):
                raise ServiceError(
                    f"field must be a non-empty string: {name}", name)
        if "sequence" not in payload:
            raise ServiceError("missing required field: sequence", "sequence")
        sequence = payload["sequence"]
        if not isinstance(sequence, int) or isinstance(sequence, bool):
            raise ServiceError("field must be an integer: sequence", "sequence")

        try:
            view, first_ack = self.store.ack_message(
                session_id, payload["message_id"],
                payload["device_id"], sequence)
        except DeliveryError as error:
            raise self._delivery_error(
                error, session_id, payload["message_id"], sequence)
        return view, 201 if first_ack else 200

    def message_status(self, session_id: str, message_id: str,
                       device_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Return one message's delivery status for its active recipient."""
        try:
            return self.store.message_delivery_status(
                session_id, message_id, device_id)
        except DeliveryError as error:
            raise self._delivery_error(error, session_id, message_id)

220	                    if not pk.revoked and not pk.consumed]

222	    def revoke_prekey(self, device: Device, key_id: str) -> bool:
223	        """Mark one of the device's pre-keys revoked. Return ``False`` if absent."""
224	        with self._lock:
225	            for prekey in device.prekeys:
226	                if prekey.key_id == key_id:
227	                    prekey.revoked = True
228	                    self._notify_change()
229	                    return True
230	            return False

232	    def revoke_device(self, device_id: str) -> Optional[Device]:
233	        """Mark the device (and its pre-keys) revoked.
234	
235	        Idempotent: a previously revoked device stays revoked. Returns the
236	        device or ``None`` when the id is unknown.
237	        """
238	        with self._lock:
239	            key = self._device_index.get(device_id)
240	            device = self._devices.get(key) if key is not None else None
241	            if device is None:
242	                return None
243	            device.revoked = True
244	            for prekey in device.prekeys:
245	                prekey.revoked = True
246	            self._notify_change()

249	    def revoke_prekey_by_id(self, device_id: str,
250	                            key_id: str) -> Tuple[Optional[Device], bool]:
251	        """Revoke one pre-key of a globally-addressed device.
252	
253	        Returns ``(device, key_found)``: ``device`` is ``None`` for an unknown
254	        device; otherwise ``key_found`` says whether *key_id* existed. Revoking
255	        an already-revoked key is idempotent and reports it as found.
256	        """
257	        with self._lock:
258	            key = self._device_index.get(device_id)
259	            device = self._devices.get(key) if key is not None else None
260	            if device is None:
261	                return None, False
262	            for prekey in device.prekeys:
263	                if prekey.key_id == key_id:
264	                    prekey.revoked = True
265	                    self._notify_change()

269	    def identity_view(self, device: Device) -> Dict[str, Any]:
270	        """Copy the device's current identity material into a three-field view."""

277	    def rotate_identity_key(self, device_id: str, identity_key: str
278	                            ) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], bool]:
279	        """Atomically rotate a device's identity key.
280	
281	        Returns ``(view, changed)``: ``changed`` is True when the key was
282	        actually replaced (and ``rotated_at`` advanced), False when the new
283	        key equals the stored one (idempotent; ``rotated_at`` untouched).
284	        Unknown -> :class:`DeviceUpdateError` ``device_unknown`` (404);
285	        revoked -> ``device_revoked`` (409). All checks and the write happen
286	        under the store lock; a failure writes nothing.
287	        """
288	        with self._lock:
289	            key = self._device_index.get(device_id)
290	            device = self._devices.get(key) if key is not None else None
291	            if device is None:
292	                raise DeviceUpdateError(DEVICE_UNKNOWN)
293	            if device.revoked:
294	                raise DeviceUpdateError(DEVICE_REVOKED)
295	            changed = identity_key != device.identity_key
296	            if changed:
297	                device.identity_key = identity_key
298	                device.rotated_at = utc_now_iso()
299	                self._notify_change()
300	            return self.identity_view(device), changed

302	    def add_prekey(self, device_id: str, key_id: str, public_key: str
303	                   ) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], bool]:
304	        """Atomically append a pre-key (or confirm an identical existing one).
305	
306	        A new ``key_id`` is appended in order and reported with ``created``
307	        True (201). An existing, non-revoked key with the same ``public_key``
308	        is idempotent (200, ``created`` False). An existing id with a changed
309	        key, or an id whose key was revoked, raises
310	        :class:`DeviceUpdateError` ``prekey_conflict`` (409/key_id). Unknown
311	        device -> ``device_unknown`` (404), revoked device -> ``device_revoked``
312	        (409). Locked; a failure writes nothing.
313	        """
314	        with self._lock:
315	            key = self._device_index.get(device_id)
316	            device = self._devices.get(key) if key is not None else None
317	            if device is None:
318	                raise DeviceUpdateError(DEVICE_UNKNOWN)
319	            if device.revoked:
320	                raise DeviceUpdateError(DEVICE_REVOKED)
321	            existing = next((pk for pk in device.prekeys
322	                             if pk.key_id == key_id), None)
323	            if existing is not None:
324	                if not existing.revoked and existing.public_key == public_key:
325	                    return ({"device_id": device.device_id,
326	                             "key_id": existing.key_id,
327	                             "public_key": existing.public_key}, False)
328	                raise DeviceUpdateError(PREKEY_CONFLICT)
329	            prekey = SignedPreKey(key_id=key_id, public_key=public_key)
330	            device.prekeys.append(prekey)
331	            self._notify_change()
332	            return ({"device_id": device.device_id,
333	                     "key_id": prekey.key_id,
334	                     "public_key": prekey.public_key}, True)
335	
336	    def public_view(self, device_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
337	        """Atomically build the public snapshot of a device.
338	
339	        The active pre-key id list is copied under the lock together with the
340	        rest of the record, so a concurrent revocation can never be observed
341	        half-applied.
342	        """
343	        with self._lock:
344	            key = self._device_index.get(device_id)
345	            device = self._devices.get(key) if key is not None else None
346	            if device is None:
347	                return None
348	            return {
349	                "identity_key": device.identity_key,
350	                "prekey_ids": [pk.key_id for pk in device.prekeys
351	                               if not pk.revoked and not pk.consumed],
352	                "registered_at": device.registered_at,
353	            }

357	    @staticmethod
358	    def claim_view(claim: PreKeyClaim) -> Dict[str, Any]:
359	        """Copy one claim into its public six-field view."""
360	        return {
361	            "claim_id": claim.claim_id,
362	            "recipient_device_id": claim.recipient_device_id,
363	            "identity_key": claim.identity_key,
364	            "key_id": claim.key_id,
365	            "public_key": claim.public_key,

367	        }

369	    def claim_prekey(self, recipient_device_id: str, claim_id: str
370	                     ) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], bool]:
371	        """Atomically claim one of a device's one-time pre-keys.
372	
373	        The whole check-and-consume runs under the store lock — the same lock
374	        session creation and device/key revocations take — so concurrent
375	        claims, session creations and revocations are linearized and exactly
376	        one claim wins a race for the last available key.
377	
378	        A previously committed *claim_id* is idempotent: its frozen record is
379	        returned unchanged (``created`` False -> 200) and no further key is
380	        consumed, regardless of intervening rotation or revocation. A fresh
381	        *claim_id* takes the first pre-key (insertion order) that is neither
382	        revoked nor already consumed, marks it consumed, and records the
383	        claim. Unknown recipient -> :class:`PreKeyClaimError`
384	        ``recipient_unknown`` (404); revoked recipient -> ``recipient_revoked``
385	        (409); no available key -> ``prekey_unavailable`` (409/field
386	        ``prekey_id``). On failure nothing is written.
387	        """
388	        with self._lock:
389	            existing = self._prekey_claims.get(claim_id)
390	            if existing is not None:
391	                return self.claim_view(existing), False
392	
393	            recipient_key = self._device_index.get(recipient_device_id)
394	            recipient = (self._devices.get(recipient_key)
395	                         if recipient_key is not None else None)
396	            if recipient is None:
397	                raise PreKeyClaimError(CLAIM_RECIPIENT_UNKNOWN)
398	            if recipient.revoked:
399	                raise PreKeyClaimError(CLAIM_RECIPIENT_REVOKED)
400	
401	            available = next((pk for pk in recipient.prekeys
402	                              if not pk.revoked and not pk.consumed), None)
403	            if available is None:
404	                raise PreKeyClaimError(CLAIM_NO_PREKEY)
405	
406	            available.consumed = True
407	            claim = PreKeyClaim(
408	                claim_id=claim_id,
409	                recipient_device_id=recipient_device_id,
410	                key_id=available.key_id,
411	                identity_key=recipient.identity_key,
412	                public_key=available.public_key,
413	            )
414	            self._prekey_claims[claim_id] = claim
415	            self._notify_change()
416	            return self.claim_view(claim), True

420	    def create_session(self, initiator_device_id: str, recipient_device_id: str,
421	                       prekey_id: str, ephemeral_key: str) -> Session:
422	        """Atomically validate and create one session.
423	
424	        Lookups, revocation checks and the insert all happen while holding the
425	        store lock (the same lock device/pre-key revocations take), so a
426	        concurrent revocation is linearized either wholly before this call
427	        (then it fails) or wholly after it (then the session is retained).
428	        On any failure nothing is written and :class:`SessionCreateError`
429	        carries the reason.
430	        """
431	        with self._lock:
432	            initiator = self._device_index.get(initiator_device_id)
433	            initiator = self._devices.get(initiator) if initiator is not None else None
434	            if initiator is None:
435	                raise SessionCreateError(SESSION_INITIATOR_UNKNOWN)
436	            if initiator.revoked:
437	                raise SessionCreateError(SESSION_INITIATOR_REVOKED)
438	
439	            recipient_key = self._device_index.get(recipient_device_id)
440	            recipient = (self._devices.get(recipient_key)
441	                         if recipient_key is not None else None)
442	            if recipient is None:
443	                raise SessionCreateError(SESSION_RECIPIENT_UNKNOWN)
444	            if recipient.revoked:
445	                raise SessionCreateError(SESSION_RECIPIENT_REVOKED)
446	
447	            used_prekey = next((pk for pk in recipient.prekeys
448	                                if pk.key_id == prekey_id), None)
449	            if used_prekey is None:
450	                raise SessionCreateError(SESSION_PREKEY_UNKNOWN)
451	            if used_prekey.revoked:
452	                raise SessionCreateError(SESSION_PREKEY_REVOKED)
453	            if used_prekey.consumed:
454	                raise SessionCreateError(SESSION_PREKEY_CONSUMED)
455	
456	            session = Session(
457	                session_id=uuid.uuid4().hex,
458	                initiator_device_id=initiator_device_id,
459	                recipient_device_id=recipient_device_id,
460	                prekey_id=prekey_id,
461	                ephemeral_key=ephemeral_key,
462	                identity_key=recipient.identity_key,
463	                public_key=used_prekey.public_key,
464	            )
465	            self._sessions[session.session_id] = session
466	            self._notify_change()
467	            return session
468

481	                "initiator_device_id": session.initiator_device_id,

492	    @staticmethod
493	    def group_view(group: Group) -> Dict[str, Any]:
494	        """Copy one group into its public five-field view."""
495	        return {
496	            "group_id": group.group_id,
497	            "revision": group.revision,
498	            "members": list(group.members),
499	            "created_at": group.created_at,
500	        }
501	
502	    def create_group(self, group_id: str, creator_device_id: str,
503	                     member_device_ids: List[str]) -> Group:
504	        """Atomically validate and create one group.
505	
506	        The id must be unused and the creator an active registered device.
507	        Member ids are arbitrary non-empty strings already validated by the
508	        service; they need not resolve to registered devices and are stored
509	        as given. The creator is always the first member; the other ids
510	        follow in request order, de-duplicated (a repeated id kept once).
511	        The creator check and the insert happen under the store lock, the
512	        same lock device revocations take, so a concurrent revocation is
513	        linearized either wholly before this call (then it fails) or wholly
514	        after it (then the group is retained). On failure nothing is written.
515	        """
516	        with self._lock:
517	            if group_id in self._groups:
518	                raise GroupError(GROUP_DUPLICATE_ID)
519	
520	            creator = self._active_device(creator_device_id)
521	            if creator is None:
522	                existing = self._find_device(creator_device_id)
523	                raise GroupError(GROUP_CREATOR_REVOKED if existing is not None
524	                                 else GROUP_CREATOR_UNKNOWN)
525	
526	            members: List[str] = [creator_device_id]
527	            seen = {creator_device_id}
528	            for device_id in member_device_ids:
529	                if device_id not in seen:
530	                    seen.add(device_id)
531	                    members.append(device_id)
532	
533	            group = Group(group_id=group_id,
534	                          creator_device_id=creator_device_id, members=members)
535	            self._groups[group_id] = group
536	            self._notify_change()
537	            return group
538	
539	    def get_group(self, group_id: str) -> Optional[Group]:
540	        """Return the stored group, or ``None`` when the id is unknown."""
541	        with self._lock:
542	            return self._groups.get(group_id)
543	
544	    def _find_device(self, device_id: str) -> Optional[Device]:
545	        """Resolve a globally-addressed device (must hold the lock)."""
546	        key = self._device_index.get(device_id)
547	        return self._devices.get(key) if key is not None else None
548	
549	    def _active_device(self, device_id: str) -> Optional[Device]:
550	        """Resolve a device that exists and is not revoked (must hold lock)."""
551	        device = self._find_device(device_id)
552	        if device is None or device.revoked:
553	            return None
554	        return device
555	
556	    def _authorize_group_actor(self, group_id: str,
557	                               actor_device_id: str) -> Group:
558	        """Resolve a group and authorize its creator (must hold the lock).
559	
560	        Unknown group -> ``group_unknown``; an unknown or revoked actor ->
561	        ``actor_unknown`` / ``actor_revoked``; an active non-creator ->
562	        ``actor_not_creator``.
563	        """
564	        group = self._groups.get(group_id)
565	        if group is None:
566	            raise GroupError(GROUP_UNKNOWN)
567	        actor = self._find_device(actor_device_id)
568	        if actor is None:
569	            raise GroupError(GROUP_ACTOR_UNKNOWN)
570	        if actor.revoked:
571	            raise GroupError(GROUP_ACTOR_REVOKED)
572	        if actor_device_id != group.creator_device_id:
573	            raise GroupError(GROUP_ACTOR_NOT_CREATOR)
574	        return group
575	
576	    def add_group_member(self, group_id: str, actor_device_id: str,
577	                         device_id: str) -> Tuple[Group, bool]:
578	        """Atomically authorize the creator and add one member.
579	
580	        Returns ``(group, created)``: ``created`` is False (200) when the
581	        active device is already a member, True (201) when it was appended.
582	        An unknown or revoked target device raises ``group_device_unknown``
583	        / ``group_device_revoked`` (404 / 409, field ``device_id``). A
584	        successful append advances the group revision; an idempotent repeat
585	        does not.
586	        """
587	        with self._lock:
588	            group = self._authorize_group_actor(group_id, actor_device_id)
589	            if device_id in group.members:
590	                return group, False
591	            target = self._find_device(device_id)
592	            if target is None:
593	                raise GroupError(GROUP_DEVICE_UNKNOWN)
594	            if target.revoked:
595	                raise GroupError(GROUP_DEVICE_REVOKED)
596	            group.members.append(device_id)
597	            group.revision += 1
598	            self._notify_change()
599	            return group, True
600	
601	    def remove_group_member(self, group_id: str, actor_device_id: str,
602	                            device_id: str) -> Group:
603	        """Atomically authorize the creator and remove one member.
604	
605	        Always succeeds with 200 semantics: a target id that is not (or no
606	        longer) on the member list is an idempotent no-op leaving the
607	        revision untouched, and a revoked device may still be removed so no
608	        revoked id lingers on the roster. The one hard failure besides the
609	        shared authorization checks is an id that has never been a
610	        registered device (``group_device_unknown`` -> 404). The creator
611	        cannot leave their own group; that request is a no-op that keeps
612	        the creator as the first member.
613	        """
614	        with self._lock:
615	            group = self._authorize_group_actor(group_id, actor_device_id)
616	            if device_id == group.creator_device_id:
617	                return group
618	            if self._find_device(device_id) is None:
619	                raise GroupError(GROUP_DEVICE_UNKNOWN)
620	            if device_id in group.members:
621	                group.members.remove(device_id)
622	                group.revision += 1
623	                self._notify_change()
624	            return group

638	    def create_group_session(self, group_id: str, initiator_device_id: str,
639	                             ephemeral_key: str) -> GroupSession:
640	        """Atomically validate and create one group session.
641	
642	        Every request creates a fresh session (a new ``session_id``);
643	        repeated POSTs are never deduplicated. The member list and group
644	        revision are frozen at creation, so later membership changes cannot
645	        alter the snapshot. The initiator must be an active *current* member
646	        of the group. On failure nothing is written.
647	        """
648	        with self._lock:
649	            group = self._groups.get(group_id)
650	            if group is None:
651	                raise GroupError(GROUP_SESSION_GROUP_UNKNOWN)
652	            initiator = self._find_device(initiator_device_id)
653	            if initiator is None:
654	                raise GroupError(GROUP_SESSION_INITIATOR_UNKNOWN)
655	            if initiator.revoked:
656	                raise GroupError(GROUP_SESSION_INITIATOR_INACTIVE)
657	            if initiator_device_id not in group.members:
658	                raise GroupError(GROUP_SESSION_INITIATOR_NOT_MEMBER)
659	
660	            session = GroupSession(
661	                session_id=uuid.uuid4().hex,
662	                group_id=group_id,
663	                initiator_device_id=initiator_device_id,
664	                ephemeral_key=ephemeral_key,
665	                members=list(group.members),
666	                revision=group.revision,
667	            )
668	            self._group_sessions[session.session_id] = session
669	            self._notify_change()
670	            return session

703	    def _authorize_sync_device(self, session_id: str, device_id: str
704	                               ) -> GroupSession:
705	        """Resolve a group session and authorize a frozen-member device.
706	
707	        Must be called while holding the store lock. Distinguishes an unknown
708	        session (``session_unknown``) from device-side failures
709	        (``device_unknown`` / ``device_inactive`` / ``device_not_member``);
710	        the service maps all three device failures to 409/device_id.
711	        Membership is the frozen snapshot, so a removed member still syncs
712	        and a later-added member cannot.
713	        """
714	        session = self._group_sessions.get(session_id)
715	        if session is None:
716	            raise GroupSyncError(SYNC_SESSION_UNKNOWN)
717	        device = self._find_device(device_id)
718	        if device is None:
719	            raise GroupSyncError(SYNC_DEVICE_UNKNOWN)
720	        if device.revoked:
721	            raise GroupSyncError(SYNC_DEVICE_INACTIVE)
722	        if device_id not in session.members:
723	            raise GroupSyncError(SYNC_DEVICE_NOT_MEMBER)
724	        return session

726	    def group_sync_page(self, session_id: str, device_id: str,
727	                        after: Optional[int], limit: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
728	        """Atomically read one ascending sync page, advancing the device cursor.
729	
730	        When *after* is ``None`` the device's stored cursor is the starting
731	        point and the cursor advances to the page's last sequence (an empty
732	        page leaves it unchanged). An explicit *after* is a one-off query:
733	        the stored cursor is neither read nor moved.
734	        """
735	        with self._lock:
736	            self._authorize_sync_device(session_id, device_id)
737	            cursor_key = (session_id, device_id)
738	            record = self._group_sync_cursors.get(cursor_key)
739	            if after is None:
740	                start = record.cursor if record is not None else 0
741	                advance = True
742	            else:
743	                start = after
744	                advance = False
745	            stream = self._messages.get(session_id, [])
746	            page = [m for m in stream if m.sequence > start][:limit]
747	            next_cursor = page[-1].sequence if page else start
748	            has_more = any(m.sequence > next_cursor for m in stream)
749	            if advance and page and (record is None
750	                                     or next_cursor > record.cursor):
751	                if record is None:
752	                    self._group_sync_cursors[cursor_key] = \
753	                        GroupSyncCursor(cursor=next_cursor)
754	                else:
755	                    record.cursor = next_cursor
756	                    record.updated_at = utc_now_iso()
757	                self._notify_change()
758	            return {
759	                "messages": [self.message_view(m) for m in page],
760	                "next_cursor": next_cursor,
761	                "has_more": has_more,
762	            }

764	    def group_sync_checkpoint(self, session_id: str, device_id: str,
765	                              cursor: int
766	                              ) -> Tuple[Dict[str, Any], bool]:
767	        """Atomically move a device's sync cursor forward, or confirm equality.
768	
769	        *cursor* must not exceed the session's largest stored sequence. A
770	        strictly greater cursor creates/advances the record (201, refreshed
771	        ``updated_at``); an equal cursor is an idempotent no-op (200, the
772	        timestamp is untouched); a smaller cursor conflicts (409/
773	        ``cursor``). The authorization checks run first: an unknown session
774	        raises ``session_unknown`` and an unknown/revoked/non-member device
775	        raises the matching device reason (all mapped to 409/device_id by the
776	        service). Returns ``(view, advanced)``.
777	        """
778	        with self._lock:
779	            session = self._authorize_sync_device(session_id, device_id)
780	            stream = self._messages.get(session_id, [])
781	            max_sequence = stream[-1].sequence if stream else 0
782	            if cursor > max_sequence:
783	                raise GroupSyncError(SYNC_CURSOR_CONFLICT)
784	            cursor_key = (session_id, device_id)
785	            record = self._group_sync_cursors.get(cursor_key)
786	            current = record.cursor if record is not None else 0
787	            if cursor < current:
788	                raise GroupSyncError(SYNC_CURSOR_CONFLICT)
789	            advanced = cursor > current
790	            if advanced:
791	                if record is None:
792	                    record = GroupSyncCursor(cursor=cursor)
793	                    self._group_sync_cursors[cursor_key] = record
794	                else:
795	                    record.cursor = cursor
796	                    record.updated_at = utc_now_iso()
797	                self._notify_change()
798	            if record is None:
799	                # No cursor has ever been advanced: the checkpoint at 0 is an
800	                # idempotent no-op anchored at the session's creation time.
801	                record = GroupSyncCursor(cursor=0,
802	                                         updated_at=session.created_at)

808	    def message_view(message: Message) -> Dict[str, Any]:
809	        """Copy one message envelope into its public seven-field view."""
810	        return {
811	            "session_id": message.session_id,
812	            "sender_device_id": message.sender_device_id,
813	            "message_id": message.message_id,
814	            "sequence": message.sequence,
815	            "nonce": message.nonce,
816	            "ciphertext": message.ciphertext,

820	    def append_message(self, session_id: str, sender_device_id: str,
821	                       message_id: str, sequence: int, nonce: str,
822	                       ciphertext: str) -> Message:
823	        """Atomically validate and append one message to a session's stream.
824	
825	        The session lookup, sender revocation check, duplicate-id check,
826	        sequence-continuity check and session-scoped nonce-replay check all
827	        happen while holding the store lock (the same lock device revocations
828	        take), so a concurrent revocation is linearized either wholly before
829	        this call (then it fails) or wholly after it (then the message is
830	        retained). The checks have one fixed priority: unknown session,
831	        inactive sender, duplicate message_id, bad sequence, duplicate nonce.
832	        A nonce already accepted in this same session is a replay and fails
833	        even when every other field is fresh; the identical nonce in a
834	        different session is accepted. On any failure nothing is written and
835	        :class:`MessageCreateError` carries the reason.
836	        """
837	        with self._lock:
838	            group_session = self._group_sessions.get(session_id)
839	            if session_id not in self._sessions and group_session is None:
840	                raise MessageCreateError(MESSAGE_SESSION_UNKNOWN)
841	
842	            sender_key = self._device_index.get(sender_device_id)
843	            sender = (self._devices.get(sender_key)
844	                      if sender_key is not None else None)
845	            if sender is None or sender.revoked:
846	                raise MessageCreateError(MESSAGE_SENDER_INACTIVE)
847	            # Only devices frozen into a group session may post into it; a
848	            # device removed after the freeze is rejected like an inactive one.
849	            if (group_session is not None
850	                    and sender_device_id not in group_session.members):
851	                raise MessageCreateError(MESSAGE_SENDER_INACTIVE)
852	
853	            stream = self._messages.setdefault(session_id, [])
854	            if any(m.message_id == message_id for m in stream):
855	                raise MessageCreateError(MESSAGE_DUPLICATE_ID)
856	            expected = stream[-1].sequence + 1 if stream else 1
857	            if sequence != expected:
858	                raise MessageCreateError(MESSAGE_BAD_SEQUENCE)
859	            used_nonces = self._used_nonces.setdefault(session_id, set())
860	            # Nonces are compared exactly as received (raw string equality);
861	            # a replay neither appends a message nor advances any sequence.
862	            if nonce in used_nonces:
863	                raise MessageCreateError(MESSAGE_DUPLICATE_NONCE)
864	
865	            message = Message(
866	                session_id=session_id,
867	                sender_device_id=sender_device_id,
868	                message_id=message_id,
869	                sequence=sequence,
870	                nonce=nonce,
871	                ciphertext=ciphertext,
872	            )
873	            stream.append(message)
874	            used_nonces.add(nonce)
875	            self._notify_change()
876	            return message

878	    def message_page(self, session_id: str, device_id: str, after: int,
879	                     limit: int) -> Tuple[List[Dict[str, Any]], int]:
880	        """Atomically read one ascending page of a session's messages.
881	
882	        Returns ``(message_views, next_after)``: the envelopes with
883	        ``sequence > after`` (ascending, at most *limit*) and the sequence to
884	        resume from — the last returned sequence, or *after* itself when the
885	        page is empty. The session lookup and the reader's revocation check
886	        run under the store lock, so a concurrent revocation is linearized
887	        either wholly before (then it fails) or wholly after this call.
888	        """
889	        with self._lock:
890	            group_session = self._group_sessions.get(session_id)
891	            if session_id not in self._sessions and group_session is None:
892	                raise MessageListError(MESSAGE_SESSION_UNKNOWN)
893	
894	            device_key = self._device_index.get(device_id)
895	            device = (self._devices.get(device_key)
896	                      if device_key is not None else None)
897	            if device is None or device.revoked:
898	                raise MessageListError(MESSAGE_DEVICE_INACTIVE)
899	            # Group sessions are readable by the frozen member set only; a
900	            # device added or removed after the freeze is not a reader.
901	            if group_session is not None and device_id not in \
902	                    group_session.members:
903	                raise MessageListError(MESSAGE_DEVICE_INACTIVE)
904	
905	            stream = self._messages.get(session_id, [])
906	            page = [m for m in stream if m.sequence > after][:limit]
907	            next_after = page[-1].sequence if page else after
908	            return [self.message_view(m) for m in page], next_after

912	    @staticmethod
913	    def _delivery_view(session_id: str, message: Message,
914	                       state: Optional["MessageDelivery"]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
915	        """Build the five-field delivery status view of one message."""
916	        return {
917	            "session_id": session_id,
918	            "message_id": message.message_id,
919	            "status": "acked" if state is not None and state.acked
920	            else "pending",
921	            "attempts": state.attempts if state is not None else 0,
922	            "sequence": message.sequence,
923	        }
